data.one_liner: Amplify Flutter plugin for push notifications using AWS Pinpoint.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Push Notifications category for Amplify Flutter that integrates with AWS Pinpoint. It handles registration, receipt, and interaction with push messages on Android and iOS. Works alongside other Amplify plugins for analytics, auth, and storage.
use_when: You need push notifications in a Flutter app backed by AWS Amplify/Pinpoint
You already use other Amplify Flutter plugins and want a unified solution
avoid_when: You require web, desktop, or Linux support for notifications
You prefer a lighter‑weight or non‑AWS notification service
strengths: Native Android and iOS support with AWS Pinpoint
Seamless integration with other Amplify plugins
weaknesses: No support for web, Windows, macOS, or Linux
Adds many Amplify dependencies, increasing app size
Requires native configuration and AWS setup
data.setup_notes: Add Amplify configuration files, update AndroidManifest (permissions, services) and iOS Info.plist (push capabilities), run amplify push, and initialize Amplify in Dart code.

alternatives.name: firebase_messaging
alternatives.why_pick_it: Google‑backed push service with cross‑platform (including web) support and a smaller dependency footprint

alternatives.name: onesignal_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides rich notification features and a dashboard without needing AWS infrastructure

alternatives.name: flutter_local_notifications
alternatives.why_pick_it: Handles local notifications and can be combined with other push services for a custom solution
